children: DynaResource received a US$4.0 million IVA refund for its Mexican subsidiary, marking progress on recovering outstanding VAT credits.
DynaResource de México received MXN $69.5M (~US$4.0M) cash from SAT on Sept 2, 2026 for IVA credits Jan–Jun 2025.
SAT approved MXN $75.0M (~US$4.4M) of IVA credits; remaining portion settled via administrative adjustments.
Cash proceeds are subject to success-based advisory fees and other recovery costs, reducing net benefit.
As of July 31, 2026, outstanding IVA receivables were MXN $500M (~US$29.3M); ~MXN $425M (~US$24.9M) still pending SAT review.
